nodes.subtitle: BanditRLProof.Thompson.sum_clippedUCB_action_sub_mean_le
nodes.description: Pathwise selected-action clipped-UCB excess bound from the pinned LML Thompson route. The only hypothesis is that every positive-count empirical mean is strictly below its arm mean plus the confidence width.
